title: How complete and correct is the first result?
description: Choose an arrival pattern, allowed lateness, delivery mode, and sink contract. The timeline reveals omitted facts, replay loss, and duplicate business effects.

scenarios.label: Fraud score window
scenarios.detail: Most events are prompt, but retries and mobile networks create a long tail.

scenarios.label: Mobile session
scenarios.detail: Offline clients reconnect with important events well after the session begins.

scenarios.label: Ad impressions
scenarios.detail: Large volume tolerates an initial estimate, but billing requires later correction.

deliveryModes.label: At most once
deliveryModes.detail: Do not replay uncertain events; failure can lose accepted facts.

deliveryModes.label: At least once
deliveryModes.detail: Replay until acknowledged; the sink must neutralize duplicates.

sinkModes.label: Idempotent upsert
sinkModes.detail: A stable event or business key turns replay into the same effect.

sinkModes.label: Blind append
sinkModes.detail: Every retry creates another side effect in the destination.
